Loss report: forgejo -> tekton
[lost] pipeline/ci/job/build job.runner (Tekton schedules pods, not runner labels)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/build/step/build-step-1 step.image: default image (the step names no image and Tekton requires one; alpine:3.22 runs it)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/trigger/0 trigger.schedule: CronJob posting to the EventListener (CronJob ci-schedule-0 posts to el-pipemaster in namespace default; deploy both in that namespace, or edit the host. The run has an empty ctx-repo because the post carries no repository. The listener entry matches only the X-Pipemaster-Schedule header, so any caller in the cluster can start a run; restrict the listener with a NetworkPolicy or add a shared-secret header)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/trigger/1 trigger.schedule: CronJob posting to the EventListener (CronJob ci-schedule-1 posts to el-pipemaster in namespace default; deploy both in that namespace, or edit the host. The run has an empty ctx-repo because the post carries no repository. The listener entry matches only the X-Pipemaster-Schedule header, so any caller in the cluster can start a run; restrict the listener with a NetworkPolicy or add a shared-secret header)
